plainText:
Mitsuaki Madono (Japanese: 真殿光昭 Madono Mitsuaki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Madono was born on July 28, 1964 in , . Madono started out voicing characters of the day during and , respectively. He was given a recurring role in as Freddy O'Martian, and would gain his most prominent role as in . Madono is currently affiliated with .
